seo.title: Attymass Brickwork – Bricklayers & Builders in North West London
seo.description: Specialists in every aspect of brickwork: new builds, extensions, renovations and all styles of pointing. Formed in 2004, with 30 years in the industry.

hero.lead: Formed in 2004 and backed by 30 years in the industry. We specialise in every aspect of brickwork, including new builds, extensions, renovations and all styles of pointing on period properties or new builds.

faqs.a: Yes. Attymass Brickwork is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.

faqs.q: Do you work on period properties?
faqs.a: Yes. We do all styles of pointing on period properties as well as new builds.

faqs.q: Do you take on commercial work?
faqs.a: Yes. We have worked on various domestic and commercial properties.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 07940 582424. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
